packages.name: KiCad Library Manager
packages.description: Toolbar button that opens KiCad Library Manager for the current project
packages.description_full: Adds a Library Manager button to the PCB editor and schematic editor toolbars. It starts the bundled klm.exe on the open board's project, where you can import parts (symbol, footprint, 3D model, datasheet, sim model) into a global or project library. Needs KiCad's API enabled (Preferences > Plugins).
